ns2:section.sectionText: Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have transformed how we interact with and use AI to make decisions. This course focuses on the human factors to consider when designing interactive intelligent systems that must be usable and beneficial, and respect human values. Topics include psychological impacts of AI, trust, privacy, AI biases and fairness, human-in-the-loop decision-making, and design guidelines. Through readings and projects, students will critically analyze existing AI systems with respect to their human impacts
